blocks.x: What about, you know Johnny Harmon? Very well. Yeah, he worked at Whirlines, didn't he?
Maybe not when you were there. Florese was in the Whirlines. Florese?
Florese, he's waking at night. He was, rather.
I think A.J. LaCosta's retired. He doesn't know about Farrell.
There was also that blind man working at Whirlines. Yeah, that old blind guy.
He worked as a guy with one of his names. What was that real name? We used to call him Fort Bell.
Well, I'll ask somebody wearing Whirlines. They might remember him.
And Eddie Benton was there for a while. Eddie Benton, he was a trombone player. Worked at Whirlines before. I didn't know him. A little probably didn't know him.
